translation.title: Felbinac Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of osteoarthritis (degenerative arthritis), periarthritis of the shoulder, tendinitis and tenosynovitis, peritendinitis, epicondylitis of the humerus (such as tennis elbow), muscle pain, and swelling and pain after an injury.
translation.usage: Peel off the release liner and apply 1 cataplasm to the affected area twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you have or have had asthma caused by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, or if you have experienced hives or acute rhinitis caused by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics. Do not use it on damaged skin or mucous membranes, or on areas with eczema or rash. Consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have bronchial asthma, if you have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to propylene glycol, if you have asthma, if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, or if the user is a child. Itching, redness, flushing, dermatitis (rash, eczema), or contact dermatitis may occur occasionally, and irritation or blisters rarely. If any of these occur, stop using it and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Store at room temperature.
